stemMd: If $\log_{10} a=2$ and $\log_{10} b=3$, what is $\log_{10}(ab)$?
explanationMd: The product rule gives log(ab)=log(a)+log(b)=2+3=5. Equivalently a=100 and b=1000, so their product is 100000.

distractorRationale.d: This concatenates the exponents rather than applying an operation.
distractorRationale.e: This is b itself, not the requested logarithm.
distractorRationale.c: This multiplies logarithms instead of adding them.
distractorRationale.a: This corresponds to a quotient in the opposite order.
